puzzles.better: Build between your fort and its friend. Joined, they share many roads.
puzzles.hint: A fort with a friend has more roads.
puzzles.say: Your fort has 3 roads. A friend stands near. Red has 3 moves to attack. Save your fort!
puzzles.title: Join, do not run to the edge

wrong.why: Your fort ran to the edge. The edge has no roads, and Red got between your fort and its friend.
Your move went into the corner. The corner has no new roads, and Red got between your fort and its friend.

puzzles.better: Build to the left of your lower tower. There your fort gets the most roads.
puzzles.hint: Count the roads for each spot. The edge gives few roads.
puzzles.say: Your fort stands on the edge. Red has 3 moves to attack. Run where your fort gets the most roads.
puzzles.title: Run to the middle

wrong.why: Your move went along the edge. The edge gives few roads, and Red closed the way to the middle.
Your move went into the corner. The corner gives no new roads.

puzzles.better: Build to the left of your tower. That way leads to open space and to your friend.
puzzles.hint: Run toward open space and your friend, away from the edge.
puzzles.say: Your tower has 3 open roads, but Red is all around. Red has 3 moves. Find the way out.
puzzles.title: Which way?

wrong.why: Your move went to the edge. There your fort had only a few roads.
Your move went down, toward the edge and the red towers.
